name: list_flows
title: List flows
description:
The flows in this workspace, by name, 50 a page: id, name, status, persona, triggers (type and
whether each is on), card count, last change and link. `status` is the flow's own switch, not live activity:
only an `active` flow starts new runs. `total` counts every match, not this page.

search.description: Case-insensitive match on the flow name.

limit.description: Rows a page, at most 100. Default 50.
